quotes.text: Bug 2069949 UI migration 65 removes SMTP servers with no hostname, clears their preferences, clears smtpServerKey on identities that referenced them, and clears the default key if it points to a removed server. The current getServerByIdentity also falls back to the default when a nonempty identity key cannot resolve, covering manual prefs edits and deleted entries. Empty username is valid for nsMsgAuthMethod.none and must not be used as an invalid-server test; D325420 review asked this exact question and the author added a comment. Migration tests cover the cleanup. Treat persisted object deletion as a reference repair, not just list removal.
